blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and the European Union (EU) have reached a substantial agreement on a free trade deal that the Marcos administration said could expand opportunities for Filipinos while strengthening the country’s position in emerging industries such as artificial intelligence and digital technologies. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. discussed the milestone with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen during a phone call on Tuesday, as both sides look ahead to the formal conclusion and eventual signing of the Philippines-EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA).
